full.alt: The custom restaurant report identifies two feasible complete repairs with Rowan available until 10 p.m.; it establishes no preference.
full.caption: Full availability leaves two feasible supplied repairs. The feasibility-only app does not rank them.

short.alt: The same restaurant report identifies one feasible complete repair when Rowan’s availability ends at 8 p.m.; Rowan’s relief repair fails full-interval availability.
short.caption: Only Rowan’s availability changes. The relief repair fails availability, while the coordinated repair remains feasible.

stability.alt: The stability-first restaurant report prefers bringing in Rowan, showing $180 additional expense, one changed published position and $836 remaining payroll.
stability.caption: Preserving published positions first makes Rowan preferred among the same four supplied repairs.

cost.alt: The cost-first restaurant report prefers the coordinated repair, showing $80 additional expense, three changed published positions and $736 remaining payroll.
cost.caption: Minimizing remaining payroll first makes the coordinated repair preferred among the same four supplied repairs.
